statement: Fix K and K∗ > K + 10. For every ϑ > 0 there are fixed constants Clen and αmin > 0, followed by constants ξ0 > 0 and Cth < ∞, with the following properties. They are chosen before z tends to infinity, and Cth is independent of 0 < ξ ≤ ξ0. Put ∆ = 2Clenξ. (7.7) For each fixed 0 < ξ ≤ ξ0 and sufficiently large z, there is a family G of regular included endpoints with rd ≤ K such that m {d included : rd ≤ K} \ G  ≤ ϑ + Cth∆ + oξ(1) B2 . (7.8) The term oξ(1) tends to zero after all fixed parameters, including ξ, have been chosen. The statement is uniform in the prescribed residue classes. The regular endpoints and their covering full boxes have these additional properties. (i) Every regular endpoint has length at most Clen log B and has an isolated position. Every used search bin, including its isolated bin, has multiplicity one. Every position satisfying xj ≤ 2K∗ + 3, rj−1 ≤ 2K∗ + 5 also has multiplicity one. The isolated position precedes every edge supplied by Lemma 7.1. (ii) For every nonempty even prefix of a regular endpoint, rj − H(xj) > 10∆. (7.9) Moving prime choices anywhere within their fixed bins changes any prefix gap by at most ∆, and changes a threshold expression rj −H(xj) by at most ∆+2h. In particular the representative gaps and exponents of every regular box satisfy rrep j ≥ H(xrep j ) + 3∆ at every nonempty even prefix. (7.10) (iii) Let B be the distinct full boxes containing at least one regular endpoint. There is a constant Cbox K , depending only on a fixed enlargement of the endpoint compact range and the allowed starting ratios, such that X B∈B m(B) ≤ Cbox K B2 . (7.11) In particular this constant is independent of ξ, ϑ, and the total number of boxes. Every tuple in these boxes is a standard path from initial gap r0 + 1, ends at gap at most K + 2 for that starting gap, and has its actual final logw J ≥ 3a⋆/4. 38 (iv) In a regular box, declare an edge a candidate if it is among the last He = ⌈2K∗ + 10⌉ positions, is after the isolated position, has multiplicity one, and can satisfy the size bounds in (7.5) for some tuple in the box. There are at most He candidates, and every witness for a regular endpoint is among them. Throughout the whole box of each candidate, writing its parent as d′ = pq and its prime as u, one has logw Y pq ≤ 2K∗ + 4, logw Y pqu ≥ 3a⋆ 4 . (7.12) The bins for p and u have lower endpoints R and U satisfying zαmin ≤ R ≤ zαmax , w ≤ U ≤ w2K∗+4 . (7.13) The choices of p, q, u, and the descendants after this edge are independent under the full-box measure. All their prime factors are disjoint. If Sq is the product of the bin upper endpoints for the factors of q, with their specified multiplicities, then 1 ≤ Sq q ≤ (1 + ξ)Clen log B . (7.14) (v) Every regular box has at least c7 log w search positions, for an absolute c7 > 0 and sufficiently large z. These positions have distinct bins. All its nonsearch positions follow all its search positions.
